summary: Verified image fix across storefront. Backend: 11/11 pytest passing (7 unit tests for _is_clean_amazon_image, 2 DB cleanup counts = 0, 2 API sanity). Frontend browser: 0 broken images on homepage (0/60), search (0/24), category=electronics (0/24). onError fallback verified — synthetic broken src is swapped to next clean image in listing.images[] (naturalWidth=1500 after fallback). Product detail hero image loads at 1500x1500. NOTE: had to restart backend once at start of test — uvicorn had become unresponsive to new connections (likely event-loop blocked by Apify sync run_in_executor call chain earlier). After restart, all endpoints served <30ms.

minor.issue: Backend became unresponsive to new HTTP connections before restart despite supervisor showing RUNNING and old requests receiving 200 OK. Possibly related to long-running Apify sync + reload=True on uvicorn. Consider disabling --reload in production or investigating thread-pool starvation.

critical_code_review_comments: ProductCard.jsx onError handler: `dataset.imgIdx` state persists on the element, but if the FIRST image (index 0) is already bad, the initial `attempted=0` combined with `i > attempted` skips index 0. The condition should also fall through to picsum on the very first failure — current code does this correctly via the else branch, verified in browser test.

apify_sync.py _is_clean_amazon_image() correctly rejects composite `._CL` / `%7C` / raw pipe URLs. Consider also stripping the encoded pipe fragment out of otherwise valid Amazon URLs rather than dropping the whole URL (defensive).
test_credentials: Not used — image render is a public-viewer flow
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend can hang after long Apify sync runs — if endpoints time out, `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` restores service. Backend tests use MongoDB Atlas directly via MONGO_URL; ensure envs are exported before running pytest.
